basis: Article 1 of the 2017 statute (Official Gazette text) gives the museum legal personality with financial and administrative independence under a statute approved by the Supreme Leader, with a board of trustees chaired by the Chief of the Armed Forces General Staff; the 2021 amendment, which gives Tehran Municipality the duty to provide budget and staff, is in force.

The Who we are section of the foundation's about page calls it an Iraqi registered non-profit, non-governmental organization and gives its registration with the Iraq Commission for Civil Society Enterprises.

The Funders and Partners section of the Board and Governance page says VISUAL is a project of Carlow Arts Centre Ltd, a company limited by share capital governed by a board of directors, with Carlow County Council as shareholder.

The Freedom of Information publication scheme on the governance page says the gallery operates as a company registered in 2006 with a board of directors and a constitution, on a not-for-profit basis, under the National Cultural Institutions Act 1997; its procurement policy and FOI scheme are on the same page.

The governance page says the Glucksman is constituted as Art Gallery (UCC) Designated Activity Company with a board of directors; the 2025 annual report (PDF page 13 on the parent, page 18 on employees) names University College Cork as ultimate parent and controlling party, states charitable purposes, and reports 12 employed persons.
Page 1 of the constitution (as amended 18 December 2023) says it is a company limited by guarantee, and its Memorandum clause 6 requires the Charities Regulator to hold the current Constitution.
